title: 'Start Your Change' gym banner with a greyscale stretching photo and a holographic starburst accent
whatItIs: A grey-bordered square banner with a bold condensed 'START YOUR CHANGE' headline, 'First Training Season Free' subline, a black 'Contact Today' pill button, thin orbit-line graphics with starburst accents, and a greyscale photo of a woman stretching against a holographic rainbow-gradient backdrop.
whatItMeans: Bold and current; the holographic gradient behind a greyscale athlete makes a standard gym offer feel fresh and premium.
techniques: Contrast a greyscale subject against a vivid holographic backdrop.
Add thin orbit-line graphics with starburst accents for energy.
Keep the CTA in a simple solid pill button.

vocabulary.definition: A shifting rainbow colour effect mimicking foil or prism material.
A small spiky shape used for emphasis.
